title: Conditional Fibonacci-step bridge through composition of a quadratic form

source.title: A Pair of Diophantine Equations Involving the Fibonacci Numbers
source.section: 2. The case of Fibonacci numbers squared

limitations: No definition or specialization to a Fibonacci sequence is formalized here.
The hypotheses c = a + b and (b^2 - a*c)^2 = 1 remain explicit.
This does not prove the entire article, its full formula (1.7), or Diophantine existence or uniqueness.
